speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a significant medical history; could you please tell me the specific diagnoses you have been managing and when your gait and limb ataxia symptoms first began? Additionally, have you experienced any sensory changes, double vision, or bladder dysfunction recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any episodes of vision loss, numbness, or weakness in the past, and do you have a family history of autoimmune disorders? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain and Spine; REQUEST TEST: Vitamin B12 and Copper levels.

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal MRI and vitamin levels, have you experienced any episodes of double vision, tingling sensations, or difficulty controlling your bladder in the past? REQUEST TEST: Vitamin E level; REQUEST TEST: Copper studies.

speaker: Doctor
text: With your normal MRI and vitamin levels, have you noticed any episodes of numbness, tingling, or weakness in your arms or legs that came and went? Additionally, do you have any family history of neurological conditions like Multiple Sclerosis or Friedreich's ataxia? REQUEST TEST: Genetic testing for Friedreich's ataxia; REQUEST TEST: Adrenoleukodystrophy panel.

speaker: Doctor
text:
With normal genetic testing and vitamin levels, have you experienced any episodes of unsteady gait that improve when you close your eyes or lean against a wall? Additionally, do you have a history of hypothyroidism or adrenal insufficiency? REQUEST TEST: Adrenal function panel (Cortisol, ACTH); REQUEST TEST: Thyroid function tests.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple sclerosis
